add.title: Let two live queries share one page: route query_row / query_stale by qid to a map of clients, not one static QueryClient.current
add.why: QueryClient.js:9 and 34-35 keep one static `current`, so a second QueryClient on a page (e.g. a 'Queue · 142' count link on the day or session page) takes the host page's live pushes away. Found by the ai/queue task (2026-10-24), which shipped its links without a count for this reason.
